root_cause.summary: The 3070x2 host serving the 3090 read-only SSHFS Arrow mount shut down at 11:29 and rebooted at 11:33:41. Memory-mapped Arrow page faults on 3090 ranks 4 and 5 then failed with SIGBUS at 11:32:06.
evidence: 3070x2 last -x records shutdown at 11:29 and system boot at 11:33
3090 node launcher records simultaneous Bus error exits for PIDs 1088257 and 1088259
3090 GPU monitoring falls from 18,652 MiB at 11:32:03 to 0% utilization at 11:32:04 and 9,404 MiB at 11:32:05
rank 7 reports ncclRemoteError after the 3090 peer closes

not_causes.cuda_oom: No CUDA OOM signature is present.
not_causes.3090_memory_pressure: After cleanup the host had 13 GiB available RAM and 6.6 GiB free swap.
not_causes.3090_failed_data_disk: The experiment dataset URI points only to /home/yabin/ctta4aid_assets/data/df_arrow_remote_3070; the failed /data dataset was not used.
not_causes.dataset_corruption: After the source reboot, the same mount passed all 19 domains, 88,353 rows, labels, mappings and first-image decoding with exit code 0.

invalid_incomplete_domain.reason: The local loop completed, but the eight-rank gather could not complete and no prediction file exists.

profile.cyclegan_timing: shared A6000; preserve but do not treat as clean

cleanup.reason: The distributed job could not recover after ranks 4 and 5 exited.
cleanup.a6000_cleanup_note: PID 1433817 had already exited between process-tree verification and the TERM command; the other experiment ranks exited and the launcher/monitor cleaned up.

recovery.exact_iapl_runtime_smoke: passed crn with 12,764 rows, 32 views, selection_count 8, averaged entropy and OIS

diagnostic_failures_preserved: The first post-reboot all-domain SSH preflight returned no captured output; the explicit-marker retry passed with exit code 0.
The first local prediction comparison used system python3 and failed because numpy was absent.
The second local comparison used the correct Conda Python but omitted required --left/--right flags and exited with argparse usage; the corrected call succeeded.
The bundled workspace-dependency lookup produced no output and was terminated after repeated waits.
The 4090-1 recovery probe timed out after five seconds.
A read-only storage inventory awk expression had a quoting syntax error; lsblk and du still completed and the error did not affect the recovery decision.
decision: Do not splice the four valid domains into a later run. Preserve attempt 1 and restart all 19 domains from seed 100 only after A6000 returns to its clean idle baseline.
